messages.content:
Please follow these steps to enable mobile data and data roaming on your phone:

To Enable Mobile Data:
1. Open the Settings app on your phone.
2. Tap on "Network & Internet" or "Connections" (the exact name may vary by phone).
3. Tap on "Mobile Network" or "Cellular Network."

5. Toggle the switch to the ON position to enable mobile data.

To Enable Data Roaming:
1. While still in the "Mobile Network" or "Cellular Network" settings.
2. Find the option labeled "Data Roaming."
3. Toggle the switch to the ON position to enable data roaming.
